name: GVDB Raycasting with Binary Search Surface Tracing
aliases: SDF Raycast with Binary Search Refinement
definition: A GPU raycasting kernel that traces rays through a GVDB sparse voxel dataset to find the first surface intersection using fixed-step marching followed by a binary search, then computes surface properties.
summary: A GPU raycasting method that traces rays through GVDB sparse voxels to find SDF isosurfaces using coarse marching and binary search refinement, distinguished by its integration with the GVDB architecture and explicit SDF gradient shading.
